mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and depressing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through joint demand signals.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising payroll employment signals tight labor market conditions that support wage growth and profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC for PAYEMS signal < 0.03 in low UNRATE regime.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1200 (thousands of units) signals weakening residential demand that depresses consumer spending and economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales indicates strong consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through demand momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals immediate monetary easing that lowers short-term borrowing costs and boosts equity market sentiment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
